slides.title: Said ou told?
slides.text: 'Said' vem sem pessoa: 'She said she was tired'. 'Told' exige pessoa: 'She told me she was tired'. Para perguntas: 'She asked if I was OK'. Errar essa regra é comum.
Ana conta a Leo o que a professora disse na aula.
slides.line: What did the teacher say, Ana?

slides.title: Messages from friends
slides.text: Ana receives many messages every day. Her friend Leo said that he was coming at six. Her mother told her to buy bread. The teacher said that the test is on Friday and told the students to study units one to five. Her boss asked if she could work on Saturday. Ana writes them all down on a small notepad so she does not forget anything. She says, "People say many things!" Leo laughs. "And you listen to all of them!" Ana smiles and closes the notepad.

slides.title: Discurso indireto
slides.formula: [said (that)] + frase no passado  |  [told] + pessoa + to + verbo
slides.rule: Ao contar o que alguém disse, o tempo costuma recuar: 'I am tired' → She said she was tired. Told exige a pessoa: told me.
